paper.title: Generator-Mediated Bandits: Thompson Sampling for GenAI-Powered Adaptive Interventions

settings.name_in_paper: Generator-mediated bandit, partially online stochastic treatment setting (offline treatment model)
unmapped: Action (query) affects reward only through a stochastic observed treatment embedding z_t ~ xi_{x,a}^{theta_1} supported on a ball of radius B in R^d; reward y_t = m_2(z_t, x_t; theta_2) + eta_t
Learner observes the treatment embedding z_t in addition to the reward
Learner has an offline empirical treatment model f_1^off with KL(f_1^off || f_1) <= eps for all (x,a), obtained via simulator access to the generator
Mean reward m_2(Z,x;theta_2) under Z ~ xi is sigma_1-subgaussian; reward noise eta is sigma_2-subgaussian
Finite context space of size C (mapped to M_ctx)
settings.definition_quote: given context $x_t$ and action $a_t$, the generator samples an intermediate treatment variable $z_t \in \mathbb{R}^d$ from a distribution $\xi^{\theta_1}_{x_t, a_t}$ ... supported on the ball $\mathbb{B}_d(B)$ ... the agent receives a noisy reward $y_t = m_2(z_t, x_t ; \theta_2) + \eta_t$, where $\eta_t$ is $\sigma_2$-subgaussian noise.

Learner observes the treatment embedding z_t
Mean reward under the treatment distribution is sigma_1-subgaussian; reward noise is sigma_2-subgaussian

settings.definition_quote: We now present regret guarantees for foGAMBITTS (Algorithm 1) in the linear reward setting, which applies when the agent does not have simulator access to the distributions $\set{\xi_{x, a}}$.

algorithms.name: Generic contextual bandit algorithm Alg run on estimated reward m_hat_2
Standard Thompson sampling over X x A

symbols.BR_hat: T-step Bayesian regret of Alg with respect to the estimated reward function m_hat_2
symbols.eps_off: KL bound between offline treatment model f_1^off and true treatment density

source.label: thm:poGAMBITTS_red
source.quote: Let $f_1^{off}$ be an empirical model for the treatment distribution satisfying \eqref{eq:foGAMBITTS_ass}. Let Alg be a contextual bandit algorithm that selects actions based on the estimated reward function $\widehat{m}_2$. Then, running Alg in the partially online stochastic treatment setting gives $T$-step Bayesian regret $BR^{Alg}_T$, with $BR_T^{Alg} \leq \mathcal{O}\paren{\widehat{BR}^{\text{Alg}}_T + T\sqrt{\varepsilon T}}$

results.notes: Reduction result; proof gives BR <= BR_hat + T B sqrt(2(T+1) eps). Restated as Theorem 4 in appendix.

symbols.sigma_2: sub-Gaussian parameter of the reward noise
symbols.eps_off: KL bound between offline treatment model and true treatment density

conditions: treatment embedding supported on ball of radius B in R^d

source.label: cor:poGAMBITTS_lin
source.quote: Let $f_1^{off}$ satisfy \eqref{eq:foGAMBITTS_ass}. If $m_2\paren{z, x_t; \theta}$ is linear in $z\in\mathbb{R}^d$, then the Bayesian regret of \poGAMBITTS{} (Algorithm~\ref{alg:poGAMBITTS}) satisfies $\text{BR}^{po:lin}_T \leq \widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\paren{\sigma_2 d \sqrt{T} + T\sqrt{\varepsilon T}}$.

results.notes: Combines Theorem 1 with Lemma 4 (TS with known f_1^off: O(sigma_2 d sqrt(T log T))).

symbols.sigma_2: sub-Gaussian parameter of the reward noise
symbols.eps_off: KL bound between offline treatment model and true treatment density
symbols.logN_cov: log of the T^-2 covering number of F in sup norm

source.label: thm:poGAMBITTS_nonlin
source.quote: Let $f_1^{off}$ satisfy \eqref{eq:foGAMBITTS_ass}. For any function class $\mathcal{F}$ with $\widehat{m}_2\in\mathcal{F}$, the Bayesian regret of \poGAMBITTS{} (Algorithm~\ref{alg:poGAMBITTS}) satisfies $\text{BR}^{po:{\mathcal{F}}}_T \leq \widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sigma_2 \sqrt{\text{dim}_E(\mathcal{F}, T^{-2}) \log \mathcal{N}(\mathcal{F}, T^{-2}, \Vert \cdot \Vert_\infty) T} + T\sqrt{\varepsilon T})$.

results.notes: Restated as Theorem 5. Lemma 8 also has an additive B*dim_E term hidden in O_tilde.

symbols.sigma_1: sub-Gaussian parameter of the mean reward m_2(Z,x) under the treatment distribution
symbols.sigma_2: sub-Gaussian parameter of the reward noise

conditions: finite context space of size C (= M_ctx)
treatment embedding supported on ball of radius B in R^d

source.label: thm:BRT_foGAMBITTS
source.quote: If $m_2\paren{z, x_t; \theta}$ is linear in $z\in\mathbb{R}^d$, the Bayesian regret of \foGAMBITTS{} (Algorithm~\ref{alg:foGAMBITTS}) satisfies $\text{BR}^{fo:{lin}}_T \leq \widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\paren{\sigma_1 \sqrt{CKT} + \sigma_2 d \sqrt{T}}$.

results.notes: Paper's C = number of contexts mapped to M_ctx. Proof also has an additive CK log term. Restated as Theorem 6.

symbols.sigma_1: sub-Gaussian parameter of mean reward under treatment distribution
symbols.B_mean: uniform bound |m_2(z,x;theta)| <= B on the mean reward

conditions: finite context space of size C (= M_ctx), contexts i.i.d.

source.quote: The Bayesian regret of the standard Thompson sampling agent that models the problem as a multi-armed contextual bandit over $\mathcal{X} \times \mathcal{A}$ is bounded by $\text{BR}_T^{standard} \leq \mathcal{O}((\sigma_1 + \sigma_2)\sqrt{CKT\log T} + BCK)$

results.notes: Baseline result adapted from Lattimore & Szepesvari Ch. 36.1; does not use treatment observations. Main text states it as O_tilde((sigma_1+sigma_2) sqrt(CKT)).

symbols.sigma_1: sub-Gaussian parameter of mean reward under treatment distribution

conditions: linear reward model in the embedding
hard instances: Bernoulli treatment distributions on {e_1, 0} with sigma_2 = 0, or deterministic known treatments reducing to linear contextual bandits (Li et al. 2019)

source.quote: The minimax regret of \texttt{foGAMBITTS} satisfies $R_T \geq \Omega\paren{\max\set{ \sigma_1 \sqrt{CKT}, \sigma_2 \sqrt{dT \log K} }}$.

results.notes: Stated as minimax regret 'of foGAMBITTS' but proof is a minimax lower bound over the problem (frequentist). Main text states it as Omega(max{sigma_1 sqrt(CKT), sigma_2 sqrt(dT)}). Regret type not precisely defined.
